speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To better understand your hand tremors and recent memory issues, can you tell me if the tremor occurs when you are at rest or when you are performing a specific action like holding a cup? Also, have you noticed any changes in your balance or gait recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. speaker: Doctor
